name: veterinary_clinic_system_067_multi_pet_household_report
instruction:
Marketing wants a multi-pet household campaign. Build the report from live data only.

1. For every owner with 2 or more ACTIVE patients, push exactly one ops_reports row report='multi_pet_household', batch_code, owner_id, owner_name (full_name from owners), pet_count, species_mix (comma-joined sorted distinct species of those active pets, no duplicates), primary_location_id (most common location_id among those pets; ties broken by lowest location_id), overdue_vax_count (number of those active pets that have at least one vaccination with due_date strictly before the episode date).
2. For every multi-pet household with overdue_vax_count > 0, push one reminder_queue row kind='multi_pet_vax_recall', status='queued', owner_id, message 'Household <owner_id> has <overdue_vax_count> pet(s) with overdue vaccinations - batch <batch_code>', queued_by='system', queued_at the episode timestamp.
3. Push one audit_log row: action='MULTI_PET_HOUSEHOLD_REPORT', actor='system', actor_role='system', target_collection='ops_reports', target_id='batch', details='Batch <batch_code> - <N> households, <M> with overdue vax', occurred_at the episode timestamp.

Do not include transferred or deceased pets. Do not create rows for owners with fewer than 2 active patients. Do not modify patients, owners, or vaccinations.
_max_steps_note: measure via live gold run in QC session
_par_steps_note: measure via live gold run in QC session

success_criteria.summary: ops_reports contains exactly one multi_pet_household row per owner with 2+ active patients, with exact fields and counts. reminder_queue contains exactly one multi_pet_vax_recall per such household with any overdue vaccination. audit_log contains the batch entry. Patients, owners, and vaccinations are unchanged.

checks.expect: one row per active multi-pet owner with correct counts and species_mix
multi-pet household counts and overdue counts agree between raw-row Python and SQL GROUP BY

hazards: Owner 3 (Ingrid Larsson) has 3 patients: active feline 5 (Clementine), active avian 248 (Lucy), and transferred feline 27 (Poppy). A solution that counts transferred patients would report 3 pets and species_mix 'avian,feline' with pet_count 3; the correct row is 2 active pets (5 and 248) with species_mix 'avian,feline'.

8 multi-pet owners have two active pets with the same name (e.g. owner 2 has two 'Cooper' canines). Grouping by (owner_id, pet_name) instead of (owner_id, patient_id) would undercount pet_count or species. The report must count by owner_id and distinct patient_id.

Some multi-pet households have all pets of the same species (e.g. owner 1 has two canines), so species_mix is 'canine' with no comma. A solution that always joins a list of two species would produce wrong output.

Overdue_vax_count must come from vaccinations.due_date < episode_date, not from appointments or reminder_queue. At 2026-09-30 there are 104 overdue patients, and 56 multi-pet households contain at least one overdue pet.
220 - 88 = 132 owners have fewer than 2 active patients and must not appear in the report. A solution that emits one row per owner (or per patient) fails the count.
